j1_rule: consume by name — never rebuild: the three seed rows point at the WP-1 1.5 golden traces as they stand

verdict_mapping.PASS: every deterministic check of the row held
verdict_mapping.WARN-and-justify: the row was evaluable but at least one deterministic check failed — reported with its stated justification, never FAIL-class (Law 3 warn-and-justify, raise-only)
verdict_mapping.RETURNED: the row could not be evaluated (malformed row, unknown runner, missing target) — returned to its author, not queued

grading: deterministic checks only — no behavioral grading
raise_only_note: raise-only — rows may be added or checks tightened, never tuned downward (Law 2)
